summary: The helium flux is made differential in kinetic energy per nucleon (bin width x Z/A) while its bins stay in rigidity and the proton flux stays per GV, so the He/p ratio divides fluxes per different variables.
code_change: analyse() takes a width argument; run_analysis passes width = WIDTH * abs_Z / A for helium (the period average keeps WIDTH).
description_change: context.json: units of flux-helium-p1 and flux-helium-p2 changed to 1/(m2 sr s GeV/n); binning still the rigidity edges.
